change: Self-hosted P2P DSH connections: pairing, connection, isolation, remote projects, shared config, reconciliation
prerequisites: A self-hosted coordination server reachable over HTTPS/WSS with public UDP, deployed per task 6.2.
A second physical computer with its own device identity, per task 7.3. Loopback self-connection cannot substitute.
Both computers running matching desktop builds with the architecture-matched Go peer, per task 6.3.

workflows.expected_native_event: Fingerprint review pane becomes visible and receives focus
invariants: the displayed fingerprint is derived locally from the real remote public key
approval is impossible without an explicit typed confirmation
no public key, token or DSH URL appears in the pane

workflows.expected_native_event: Pair becomes active on both computers
invariants: a pending result never reports success
an identity substituted between confirmation and readback is refused
an unknown write outcome blocks further writes until a readback

workflows.expected_native_event: Remote workbench becomes usable in its own Run tab
invariants: punching and starting-runtime are never presented as connected
the local DSH entry URL never appears in renderer state
no relay is used; a non-direct path is reported as direct_unavailable

workflows.expected_native_event: Authorized roots from the other computer become visible
invariants: path resolution happens on the remote computer using its own platform rules
navigation uses only opaque references issued by the remote side
a location outside an authorized root is refused, never clamped
missing, forbidden and empty directories are distinct states

workflows.expected_native_event: Remote DSH opens the chosen project and completes a verification task
invariants: remote file changes and task results are read back independently on the remote computer
the local computer's files are unchanged
DSH's own permission and approval policy is not bypassed

workflows.expected_native_event: Disconnect warning appears and survives a reconnect
invariants: a lost connection is never reported as a stopped or finished task
reconnecting does not clear the warning
nothing is retried, resubmitted or inferred automatically

workflows.expected_native_event: New endpoints are saved and the old test result is invalidated
invariants: a new address is accepted only when it proves the same pinned identity
any busy computer sharing the service blocks the save
a failed save leaves the stored configuration byte-identical and triggers no reconnect
input is preserved on every failure

workflows.expected_native_event: Revoked computer loses access while Local and other peers keep working
invariants: a revoked pair keeps its record but can never reconnect
its fixed session partition is not reused by another computer
Local and other peers are unaffected
no listener, process or credential is left behind
